title: THE UNMADE — Ability Codex
goal: Anything demonstrating a repeatable skill, technique, or supernatural principle may become a subject of study, but observation never automatically grants a power.
authority: Canonical index of discovery, acquisition and status; cited production C++ remains authoritative for runtime effect, costs and save identity until explicitly migrated.

states.source_rule: implemented portable rules, engine behavior unverified
states.prototype_handler: connected Unreal C++ source, uncompiled in engine
states.definition_only: registered but no verified usable unlock
states.proposed: future design, not available to player

observation_policy: A witnessed repeating principle may be studied, but not automatically copied. The first playable study slice implements three named creature subjects and the physical Echo Well; additional abilities require authored evidence, trials, bounded effects and save integrity.
